name: acoustic
note: Fitted, not guessed. 38 isolated notes of a Steinway & Sons model B from the University of Iowa MIS collection (C1-C7 in minor thirds, pp/mf/ff), measured by fp30x_studio.synth.analysis and pooled by fp30x_studio.synth.fit; raw per-note numbers in ~/workspace/audio/timbre-data/iowa-fits.json, coefficient-by-coefficient provenance in iowa-fit-report.json, the argument in docs/timbre-fit.html. B(A4)=6.5e-4 rising 0.386 decades/octave (a decade every 31 semitones, not 60) with a 1.39e-4 floor below the bass break. Rolloff 3.02 at A4 rising 0.64/octave: the old flat 1.25 was the single largest error, giving a treble note twenty partials the instrument does not have. tau_1 0.75 s at A4 halving every 15.5 semitones, against 2.4 s and 24. Aftersound 0.0106 of the prompt sound, against 0.22. Unfitted and flagged as such: hammer_noise, the two release times, damper_decay_exponent, and the four pedal-geometry terms. The tine fields are zeroed, not omitted: the schema is shared and every key is always present.
